q: How much does it cost to build a house in Islamabad?
a: Cost depends on plot size, finish level and current material rates. As a guide, a grey structure is usually quoted per square foot and a turnkey finish adds roughly 60–80% on top. After a free site visit we issue a written, itemised estimate with material brands named, so the number you see is the number you pay — no hidden extras midway.

q: How long does a 5 Marla or 10 Marla house take to build?
a: A 5 Marla home typically takes 10–12 months and a 10 Marla home 12–16 months from foundation to handover, assuming approvals and payments stay on schedule. You get a milestone plan up front and an update at every stage, so you always know where your project stands.

q: Do you provide architectural drawings and 3D elevations?
a: Yes. Our certified architects prepare complete layout plans, structural drawings and photo-realistic 3D front elevations before construction starts, so you can see and approve your home before a single brick is laid.

q: How do you prove the materials are good quality?
a: We use A+ grade materials and send steel, cement and block samples for independent lab testing. You receive the lab reports along with the material invoices — transparency backed by documents, not verbal promises.

We deal without interest, avoid gharar (hidden uncertainty) in contracts, pay labour before their sweat dries, and quote one honest price. Our investor programme uses a Musharakah-style 60/40 profit-and-loss share rather than a fixed guaranteed return.

q: How does the 60/40 investor partnership work?
a: You provide the capital, we handle land acquisition, design, construction and sale. Profit on the completed project is shared 60% to the investor and 40% to IDEAL Developments, with a transparent cost breakdown at every stage. Risk is shared, as Shariah requires — there is no fixed guaranteed return.

q: Which areas around Islamabad do you work in?
a: We build across Islamabad and Rawalpindi, including Multi-Garden B-17, B-18, DHA, Bahria Town, Gulberg, PWD and the surrounding housing societies. Our office is at 77 Square, E-block, Multi-Garden B-17.

q: Can you renovate or extend an existing house?
a: Yes. We handle structural repairs, full interior remodelling, kitchen and bathroom upgrades, façade changes and vertical extensions. We start with a site inspection and give you a visual preview plus a fixed scope before any demolition begins.
